title: Enterprise Onboarding, Integration & Escalation Playbook (QBR + Health Checks)
author: Priya Kapoor
content:
Overview:

This playbook consolidates enterprise onboarding, integration best practices, the escalation matrix, known issues and workarounds, and the standard Quarterly Business Review (QBR) / health check materials we use for Redwood Inference customers. It is intended for Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Solutions Engineers (SEs), and Support Engineers responsible for enterprise accounts.

Goals:
- Enable predictable, low-friction onboarding for enterprise customers.
- Provide a deterministic escalation path for operational incidents.
- Document integration patterns, required configuration, and testing steps to reduce time-to-first-success.
- Standardize health checks and QBR deliverables to drive product adoption and renewal.

Audience:
- Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Support, Escalation Engineers, Account Executives.
